title: Dex-aiagentkit
tagline: make dexscreener actions to fetch data from dex in the agentkit
description:
we created an action provider to get the dexscreener data in ai-agent-kit. It would be very useful to have token information that can be fetched from the dex.

Actions include:
-Get pairs by chainId and pairId from Dexscreener
-Get all token pairs for given token addresses from Dexscreener
-Search for pairs matching a query string on Dexscreener
how_its_made:
the project use https://github.com/coinbase/agentkit , and forked.
implement features to binding dexscreener api in action providers. then added unit test & completed e2e test with example app.
mostly the code was written by typescript

created issue & send PR:  https://github.com/coinbase/agentkit/issues/313
https://github.com/coinbase/agentkit/pull/314
